band_definition: Pointwise observed minimum/maximum over seeds42–46; no calibrated interval.
selection_scope: All four cases are selected using GNN errors, so median and tail labels refer only to that model's five-seed mean case-error distribution. The matched-DeepSets curves provide paired context, not a representative sample of that baseline's typical/tail cases or an unbiased estimate of model advantage. Preserve the fixed display order: median, 95th percentile, maximum mean case MAE, largest remaining mean positive peak.
